cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Enter on My Side
cards.instruction: Recruit them into your side of a contest or bargain before the stakes become fully clear.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Back my fete stall as joint entrant. Sign on this line; I'll handle the rest of the form.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: First tell me what that penalty clause means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We need to establish the parties before interpreting their obligations. Please put your full name, not initials.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll help set up, but I'm not signing up to a penalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then enter 'setup partner' beside your name. Keep it inside the joint-entry box, please; once you're listed, we can work through what applies to you.

reason: B's limited help becomes a carefully placed entry, showing recruitment through professional form interpretation.
